posts.author: Siddharth_Sawhney
posts.text: Need help creating this scanner on Streak — Hey ! On my platform , you don’t need to go through complicated dropdown menu’s or even understand which tabs to click. Just write your query in plain english . - NSE stocks where today’s first 15-minute candle was green and the next two 15-minute candles both closed below the first candle’s high Due to today’s market movement, you get a lot of stocks matching this category. You can further filter by adding more conditions like market cap , indicators, % or rupee moves, shares traded etc. Hope this helps. image 1826×1390 332 KB Happy screening.
